description: CREATE a game-ready prop GLB (kart, crate, banana, barrier…) and save it to Library as kind=prop. Default Meshy, no T-pose, no rig. polycount default 4000. Quoted against the shared subscription, or 10 GripForge credits if it cannot cover the complete operation. Returns a durable job_id; poll gripforge_generation_read. provider=compute (GripForge Compute, only when asked): stage=quote (free) then stage=generate with quote_token + confirm=true; router type, size, several assets (items), text → four images to validate (gripforge_compute_validate) unless auto_pick; returns studio_url.

auto_pick.description: provider compute, text: true = take the first of the four images without asking (only when the user wants it). Default with stage: stop on the images; show them (gripforge_generation_read images[]) and validate one with gripforge_compute_validate

concept_item.description: Owned concept image in this workspace (image-to-3D): Meshy by default, or our GPU with provider gpu (Hunyuan or TRELLIS.2 from this exact image).

concept_items.description: 2–4 distinct owned views of the SAME prop for Meshy multi-image-to-3D. Do not combine with concept_item. Geometry standard/2k only. With provider gpu + engine trellis2: exactly 4 level views in the order front, left, back, right — Pixal3D builds the shape from all four.

confirm.description: provider compute, stage=generate: true once the user accepted the quoted price

engine.description: GPU engine, only with provider gpu: hunyuan (Hunyuan3D 2.1, shape then paint) or trellis2 (TRELLIS.2). Server default GRIPFORGE_GPU_ENGINE, else hunyuan.

idempotency_key.description: Stable asset request key; reuse after an uncertain response.

image_base64.description: provider compute, source=image: PNG/JPEG/WebP, raw base64 or data URI, up to 8 MB

image_path.description: provider compute, source=image: local PNG/JPEG/WebP file (instead of image_base64)

items.description: provider compute: several assets at once, [{name, prompt} or {name, image_base64|image_path|concept_item}], one quote and one job each

meshQuality.description: Meshy geometry and PBR texture quality. Requested texture resolution is retained through optimization.

object_type.description: provider compute: size (budget) of the type, e.g. petit_objet, mobilier_simple; default: the type's default

optimize.description: Default true; false retains the provider mesh for close-up review.

options.description: provider compute, image assets: photo, matieres, relief (default all three)

out_dir.description: After the durable job completes, use gripforge_library_pull with this out_dir.

prompt.description: Required, except provider compute with an image or items. e.g. compact orange open-cockpit racing kart, isolated. Up to 2000 characters: the on-demand GPU (provider gpu) always takes them; another provider refuses a text over its own limit with the error prompt_too_long_for_provider.

provider.description: Default meshy (or the server default). gpu = our rented GPU: Hunyuan3D 2.1 (default engine) or TRELLIS.2 image-to-3D, then the game-ready chain (shape gate, normalisation, decimation, normal + AO bake from the high-poly, collider for props/weapons, meta.gameReady verdict); text-only first makes a concept image; no Tripo/Meshy spend. The server default can be gpu (GRIPFORGE_FORGE_DEFAULT=gpu|meshy). compute = GripForge Compute, ONLY when the user asks for it: textured asset from text, one image (concept_item, image_base64) or several (items), two GLBs (scene, detail), quoted and charged like the other providers; type picks the router asset type (furniture, building, vegetation, vehicle, character…); weapons are refused; refused while Compute is closed. Without provider the default generator is used.

quality.description: provider compute: texture quality, default standard

quote_token.description: provider compute, stage=generate: quote.token of the quote with the SAME inputs

quote_tokens.description: provider compute, stage=generate with items: the quote tokens in item order

source.description: provider compute, single asset: default text when only prompt is given, image with image_base64 / image_path / concept_item

stage.description: provider compute: quote first (free, returns quote.token and the price), then generate with quote_token and confirm=true. Without stage, provider compute quotes and launches in one call (a text takes its first image).

subtype.description: vehicle: made as the Vehicles prop sub-kind — no grip style, nose on +Z, the four wheels split with hub pivots so it drives. Then finished like a game car: paint, glass, chrome, grille and lamp materials, smoothed body, modelled wheels. Detected from the prompt (car, truck, van, kart…) when omitted; none opts out.

triangles.description: provider compute, image assets: exact triangle count of the « near » GLB (the « scene » one gets half)

type.description: provider compute: router asset type (gripforge_compute_status lists those available now). personnage / mob / creature: the mesh only; rig it afterwards in the Character studio. Weapons are refused

workspace_id.description: Explicit workspace id. The key must have access to it.

name: gripforge_generate_prop
